title: Machine selection
description: Projects share universe Test Machines and compete for each host's one serial lease through one queue. Test Machines of one kind are identical, so a case selects hosts only by method_config.os, method_config.capability_tags or OS slots in method_config.test_machines; naming a host on a case refuses test_machine_name_forbidden at authoring and at plan begin or case run. Single-host admission derives OS only from method_config.os, executable steps or capability requirements and automatically admits only verified, healthy hosts. The selected host must carry every tag declared in method_config.capability_tags. Machine settings store capability_tags as comma-separated text. When every matching host is leased, the refused single-host case joins the one Test Machine queue eligible for every verified host matching its OS and tags; whichever of them frees first goes to the oldest waiter it can serve, so a second host of the same OS serves the same queue. A case resuming on the host holding its state waits only for that host. Use yoke qa case run --requirement-id N --test-machine NAME to pick one host for one run of a machine-backed case; the choice is never stored and its OS and capability tags still apply. A yoke qa plan run --test-machine host that fails a case's OS or tags refuses test_machine_constraint_mismatch naming them. Item and deployment plan runs group cases by declared OS or OS slots. When one execution prepares walks on different hosts, their leases are acquired at one queue place and each walk uses its recorded driver through walk-end. Instructions never choose an OS. An undeclared platform refuses with test_machine_platform_undeclared and asks for method_config.os or OS slots. A slotted case lists at least two OS slots with exactly one driver and no singular os, or refuses test_machine_set_invalid; its capability_tags is an object from slot OS to tags, applied to every slot of that OS, and a list refuses test_machine_set_invalid. Each slot queues as its own any-of need at the execution's one place, and the set is admitted only when every slot has a free, verified, healthy host, each slot taking the lowest-named eligible host no earlier slot took; otherwise nothing is acquired and every slot keeps its place. A missing platform refuses with registration and verification recovery.
